Formula / Description: Percentage of new registrations that complete at least one full practice test within 7 days of sign-up. (Activated users / New sign-ups in cohort).
Median hours from sign_up to first practice_test_complete. The shorter this is, the higher every downstream conversion rate becomes.
Percentage of new users who finish the onboarding wizard, plus per-step drop-off rates.
Percentage of new users who provide a scheduled exam date. Unlocks days-until-test segmentation across every other metric.
Diagnostic tests completed / diagnostic tests started. Your earliest reliable read on product-experience friction.
Total practice_test_complete events / weekly active users. Your core usage-depth metric.
practice_test_complete / practice_test_start, split by Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking. Expect Speaking and Writing to lag sharply.

KPI Name: Test Abandonment Rate & Median Exit Point
Formula / Description: Percentage of started tests never submitted, plus the median percent_complete at exit. Clustering at one point signals a bug.
Percentage of active users who submit at least one Speaking task, and the microphone-denial rate among those who try.
ai_score_returned / ai_scoring_requested. Anything below 99% is actively generating refund requests.
Median and 95th-percentile time from submission to feedback delivery, by module.
Percentage of positive ratings on ai_feedback_rated. Track across model or prompt changes.
Weekly active users and the weekly-to-monthly stickiness ratio. Better suited than DAU/MAU to a product used in study bursts, not daily.
Sessions and tests completed, bucketed by days remaining before the exam (60+, 30-59, 14-29, 0-13). Reveals your true usage curve.
Average change in estimated CLB between a user's first and most recent practice test. The only metric that proves your product works.
Percentage of engaged users who reach their self-declared target CLB in practice. Powers testimonials, landing-page claims and paid ad creative.
Percentage of incorrect answers where the user opens the explanation. Strong leading indicator of renewal.
Percentage of scheduled study tasks completed on time by users with an active plan.
Sign-ups attributed to organic content sessions / organic content sessions, by landing page and content cluster. Connects your SEO work to revenue.
Purchases / paywall_view events. The most honest conversion rate in the business, because the denominator has real intent.
begin_checkout / view_item_list. Isolates price objection from checkout friction.
1 minus (purchase / begin_checkout). Anything above roughly 60% points to a fixable payment-flow problem.
Declined charges / total charge attempts, broken out by decline reason and card country. Often the single largest recoverable leak for a newcomer-heavy audience.
Conversion rate segmented by days remaining before the exam. Expect a sharp spike inside 14 days — this should drive your pricing and email timing.
Median days from first_visit to purchase. Defines how long your nurture sequence needs to be.
Paid conversion rate of users grouped by their original landing page. Identifies which SEO pages bring buyers, not just traffic.
Percentage of purchases using a coupon, and the average discount percentage. Rising values mean you are buying growth with margin.

KPI Name: D1 / D7 / D30 Retention by Cohort
Formula / Description: Percentage of each sign-up cohort returning on day 1, 7 and 30. The standard retention curve your current list is missing.
Cancellations split between user-initiated and payment-failure-driven. Involuntary churn is often 20-40% of the total and is fixable with dunning alone.
Percentage of failed recurring charges recovered through retries and dunning emails within 14 days.
Distribution of cancel_reason_submit values. Separates 'exam finished' (natural, expected) from 'too expensive' or 'not useful' (fixable).
Percentage of subscribers who cancel within 14 days of their recorded test date. Structural to test prep — quantify it so you stop mistaking it for product failure.
Percentage of churned users who resubscribe within 90 days. Often cheaper than net-new acquisition, especially for exam retakers.
(Starting MRR + expansion - contraction - churn) / starting MRR. The single best summary of subscription health.
MRR gained from upgrades and lost from downgrades, reported separately from new and churned MRR.
(New MRR + expansion MRR) / (churned MRR + contraction MRR). Above 4 is healthy growth; below 1 means you are shrinking.
Refunds and disputes as a percentage of transactions. Chargebacks above 1% put your payment processing at risk.
Percentage of past subscribers who return for a second exam cycle. Real, underused LTV for a product tied to a repeatable test.
Total AI inference spend / active paid subscribers. Your dominant variable cost, since Writing and Speaking grading scales with usage.
(Revenue - hosting - AI inference - payment fees - content licensing) / revenue.
ARPU minus variable cost to serve per subscriber. The number that makes LTV trustworthy.
Months of contribution margin required to recover CAC. Similar in spirit to your Months to Breakeven, but margin-based rather than revenue-based.
Revenue attributable to organic traffic / organic sessions x 1000. Converts SEO effort into a dollar figure you can compare against paid.
Total spend / all new customers, versus paid spend / paid-attributed customers. The gap is the value your organic channel contributes.

KPI Name: Organic Clicks, Impressions, CTR, Position by Cluster
Formula / Description: Search Console metrics grouped by page cluster (score guides, wiki, practice pages, blog). Catches ranking or snippet losses within a day.
Count and list of queries ranking in positions 4-15 with meaningful impressions. Your highest-ROI internal-linking and optimisation queue.
Organic clicks split between branded and unbranded queries. Non-brand growth is the only proof your SEO is compounding.
Valid indexed pages versus excluded or errored pages. A silent drop here precedes a traffic drop.
Conversions where a channel appeared in the path but was not the last click. Prevents you from cutting a channel that quietly does the persuading.
Ticket volume normalised to active users. A spike is usually the fastest signal of a shipped bug.
Ranked ticket categories. Recurring themes should convert into product fixes, not more help articles.
Net promoter or satisfaction score surveyed immediately after a score report is viewed.

KPI Name: Core Web Vitals on Key Templates
Formula / Description: LCP, INP and CLS for test-taking pages and top organic landing pages. Affects both rankings and completion rates.
JavaScript exceptions and failed test submissions per 1,000 sessions, segmented by browser and device.

KPI Name: Mobile vs Desktop Conversion & Completion Gap
Formula / Description: Difference in sign-up rate, purchase rate and test completion rate between mobile and desktop. A large gap on a mobile-majority audience is expensive.
